title: Venture Anatomy Matrix
description: The framework's Venture Anatomy Matrix (EE-157), packages/naive/src/functions/strategy/venture-anatomy.json: the venture's architecture description after ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010:2022. Each sub-matrix is a model naming the record types it reads, its owning function, the Regulation S-K items it covers, the phase from which it is expected and how it nests. Each viewpoint frames concerns and selects the sub-matrices a view of the venture reads. It holds no venture data.

time.description: How application time and system time are kept

source.description: The reference id of the disclosure standard the coverage check follows

id.description: The S-K item number, or S-X for the financial statements

concern.description: The question this model answers about the venture (a concern, ISO 42010)

record.description: The record type that holds this model; null when none exists yet (status not built)

also.description: Further record types this model reads

boxes.description: When record is lean-canvas: the canvas boxes that are this model's cells

owner.description: The function data-model.json gives the record type

covers.description: The coverage items (S-K item ids) this model answers

in.description: The sub-matrix each record of this one sits in

field.description: The field that names the record it sits in

holds.description: What each record of this one holds

record.description: The record type that holds the nested parts

concerns.description: Whose concerns the viewpoint frames, and which

source.description: A reference id or citation for the viewpoint's convention

definition.description: A repository file that defines the view in full, such as the Lean Canvas

reads.description: The sub-matrix ids the view reads

kind.description: How the view is drawn: canvas renders the definition file (the Lean Canvas), outline orders the sub-matrices by coverage item (an S-1 outline), submatrices lists them in matrix order
